The element \(s=2p-1-2/p\) satisfies \(s^2=-15\) and is exactly the fixed quadratic field of \(p\mapsto-1/p\). Factoring over that field and adjoining the quadratic discriminant gives \(K=\mathbb Q(\sqrt5,\sqrt{-3})\). Direct coefficient substitution proves equation descent. The packaged checker replays every critical identity.
